_note: Built by engine/build_provenance.py from audit A2_data_dictionary.csv (and A2/A4 notes). Levels come from the audit, never from column names.

levels.MEASURED: Verified against a named data product in the repository.
levels.DERIVED: A stated formula applied to a measured value (or a copy of a derived value). A formula on an UNDOCUMENTED or MODELLED value takes that weaker level.
levels.MODELLED: A formula or constant invented in code; not data.
levels.UNDOCUMENTED: A cached array whose product, date and method are not documented (the audit's 'NOT DETERMINED'). It may be real data, but it cannot be presented as measured.

elevation_m.label: Elevation
elevation_m.description: Surface height. Earth: above sea level (ocean cells are a constant -250 m fill). Moon: above the 1737.4 km reference sphere.
elevation_m.range_source: config.py:80 (Earth) and config.py:90 (Moon), per the data dictionary; no external source cited

EARTH.claimed_source: SRTM gap-filled with ASTER GDEM (README.md:39); web says NOAA ETOPO1/SRTM30 (web/index.html:372)
EARTH.code: earth_extractor.py:137-152 loads earth_global_real.npz['elevation_m'] (origin undocumented); land values match real geography; ocean = constant -250 (10,273 cells)
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Loaded from earth_global_real.npz of undocumented origin; land pattern matches real geography, ocean is a -250 m fill.

MOON.code: lunar_extractor.py:61-84 loads moon_global_pds.npz['elevation_m'] = exact 8x8 block mean of data/cache/ldem_4.img rolled to -180..180 (max abs diff 0.0, a2scripts/moon2.py)
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Exact 8x8 block mean of LOLA LDEM_4 (verified); a 2-degree cell hides all relief below about 61 km.

elevation_m.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

elevation_rel_m.label: Relative elevation
elevation_rel_m.description: Elevation minus a mean (Earth: minus the land mean, ocean fixed at -1000 m; Moon: minus the global mean).
elevation_rel_m.range_source: config.py:81 and config.py:91 per the data dictionary; no external source cited

EARTH.code: npz array: land = elevation_m - 1047.422 (land mean); ocean = constant -1000 (not -250-1047.4) (a2scripts/npzcheck.py)
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Land = elevation_m - 1047.4 m; the ocean value -1000 m is inconsistent with the -250 m fill.
EARTH.level_note: The audit calls this DERIVED, but it is a formula on elevation_m, whose level on this body is UNDOCUMENTED; a derived value cannot be stronger than its input.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Elevation minus the global mean, exact; inherits the 2-degree block mean.

elevation_rel_m.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

slope_deg.label: Slope
slope_deg.description: Mean terrain slope of the cell.

EARTH.code: npz array, method not reproducible: corr 0.60 with compute_slope_and_roughness(elev,225 m) (npzcheck.py); ocean = 0.01
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Cached array; cannot be reproduced from its elevation (corr 0.60). Method unknown.

MOON.claimed_source: 2D gradient of DEM (README.md:41); web says LOLA LDSM_16 (web/index.html:619)
MOON.code: npz array; not the code formula (corr 0.31) nor mean 4-ppd ldem_4 gradient (corr 0.63) (moon3.py)
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Cached array; neither the repo formula nor the 4-ppd LOLA gradient reproduces it. Method unknown.

slope_deg.comparability_note: Same quantity name, but measured over different areas: a 2-degree cell is about 222 km on Earth and 61 km on the Moon, and the methods behind the cached arrays differ or are undocumented (A2 sections 2a and 3). Kept, with this caveat.

roughness_m.label: Roughness
roughness_m.description: Spread of elevation inside the cell.

EARTH.claimed_source: local 3x3 std (README.md:42; GeoTIFF band label harmonizer_cleaner.py:166)
EARTH.code: npz array, method not determined; ocean = 0.1
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Cached array, method undocumented; ocean is a 0.1 m fill. Labelled 'local 3x3 std' in code, which is not verified.

MOON.code: npz = std of the 64 ldem_4 pixels (7.58 km each) in each 2-deg cell (max diff 2e-4, moon3.py) - not a 3x3 std
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Standard deviation of the 64 LDEM_4 pixels (7.6 km each) in the cell, not a 3x3 std as labelled.

roughness_m.comparability_note: Same quantity name, but measured over different areas: a 2-degree cell is about 222 km on Earth and 61 km on the Moon, and the methods behind the cached arrays differ or are undocumented (A2 sections 2a and 3). Kept, with this caveat.

temp_k.label: Surface temperature
temp_k.description: Surface temperature. Earth: described as a daytime land surface temperature. Moon: a night-time-like value.
temp_k.range_source: config.py:84 and config.py:94 per the data dictionary (> 0 K by definition)

EARTH.claimed_source: MODIS LST x0.02 with ASTER fallback (README.md:43); web: NOAA NCEP (web/index.html:622)
EARTH.code: npz array, origin undocumented; R2 0.92 vs cos(lat)^1.1+elevation; ocean = constant 285
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Cached array of undocumented origin; ocean is a constant 285 K.

MOON.claimed_source: Diviner (README.md:43); cited products dgdr_st_clc/st_avg cover 60S-60N only (labels)
MOON.code: npz array, origin undocumented; has values to +-89 deg; Tycho cell 109.8 K vs row mean 92.8 K
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Cached array; values reach +-89 deg although the cited Diviner products cover only 60 S-60 N. Source not determined.

temp_k.comparability_note: Same quantity name on both bodies, but Earth is described as a daytime land surface temperature and the Moon as a night-time-like value (A2 section 3), so the comparison mixes times of day. Kept, with this caveat, because the ice and thermal missions have no other temperature.

rock_or_bare_frac.label: Rock or bare-ground fraction
rock_or_bare_frac.description: Earth: fraction of bare ground. Moon: rock abundance.

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Cached array of undocumented origin (claimed ASTER 1-NDVI); ocean is 0.

MOON.claimed_source: Diviner rock abundance (README.md:44); cited RA product covers 60S-60N only
MOON.code: npz array; Tycho cell = max 0.0463; values exist poleward of 60 deg
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Cached array; values exist poleward of 60 deg where the cited Diviner product has none.

rock_or_bare_frac.comparability_note: Different quantities: bare-ground fraction on Earth (0-0.98) and rock abundance on the Moon (0.0015-0.046) (A2 section 2a). Their similarity measured how vegetated an Earth cell is.

sar_sigma0_db.label: Radar backscatter
sar_sigma0_db.range_source: config.py:85 and config.py:95 per the data dictionary; no external source cited

EARTH.code: npz array; land values = -18.29 + 7.97*rock + 0.452*slope with R2 0.9905 (moon3.py); ocean = -24
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Fits -18.29 + 7.97*rock + 0.452*slope with R2 0.99: behaves as a formula, not as radar data.

MOON.code: npz array = -19.2 + 45*rock + 0.22*slope exactly (residual 2e-6, npzcheck.py); 17 cells IQR-replaced (audit csv)
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Exactly -19.2 + 45*rock + 0.22*slope: a formula; no lunar radar product is read.

sar_sigma0_db.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

mask_fraction.label: Mask fraction
mask_fraction.description: Formula used by the common gate as 'cell with enough data'.

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: A formula on elevation (0 on ocean), not a data-coverage fraction.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong

mask_fraction.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

slope_300m_deg.label: Slope (named 300 m baseline)
slope_300m_deg.description: Rover gate and soft variable. Despite the name it is a copy of slope_deg at 2-degree resolution.

EARTH.claimed_source: 300 m baseline slope (name); VIPER limit source mission_filters.json:12
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Copy of slope_deg (2-degree cell), not a 300 m baseline slope.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Copy of slope_deg (2-degree cell), not a 300 m baseline slope; no LOLA product uses 300 m.

slope_300m_deg.comparability_note: Same quantity name, but measured over different areas: a 2-degree cell is about 222 km on Earth and 61 km on the Moon, and the methods behind the cached arrays differ or are undocumented (A2 sections 2a and 3). Kept, with this caveat.

rough_300m_m.label: Roughness (named 300 m baseline)
rough_300m_m.description: Rover gate and soft variable. Despite the name it is a copy of roughness_m at 2-degree resolution.

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Copy of roughness_m (2-degree cell), not a 300 m baseline value.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Copy of roughness_m (std of 7.6 km pixels in a 2-degree cell), not a 300 m baseline value.

rough_300m_m.comparability_note: Same quantity name, but measured over different areas: a 2-degree cell is about 222 km on Earth and 61 km on the Moon, and the methods behind the cached arrays differ or are undocumented (A2 sections 2a and 3). Kept, with this caveat.

irradiance_kwh_m2_day.label: Solar irradiance
irradiance_kwh_m2_day.description: Daily solar energy on a horizontal surface, from a fitted formula.

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Formula on latitude, bare fraction and elevation; no NASA POWER data was downloaded.

MOON.code: same Earth-style formula applied to the Moon
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: The same Earth-style atmospheric formula applied to the airless Moon.

irradiance_kwh_m2_day.comparability_note: The lunar value is the Earth atmospheric formula fed with rock abundance where Earth uses bare-ground fraction (A2 sections 2c and 3); it is not a lunar irradiance, and its similarity tracked Earth bare fraction.

sun_elev_max_deg.label: Maximum sun elevation
sun_elev_max_deg.description: Highest sun elevation over the year, from latitude.

EARTH.code: harmonizer_cleaner.py:256 clip(90-|lat|+11.7,1.5,90) - 11.7 is half the 23.44 deg obliquity
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: 90 - |lat| + 11.7 deg; the constant is about half Earth's 23.44 deg obliquity.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: 90 - |lat| + 1.54 deg (lunar axis tilt); geometry only, no topographic shading.

sun_elev_max_deg.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

sun_low_frac_0_5deg.label: Low-sun fraction (0-5 deg)
sun_low_frac_0_5deg.description: Share of time with the sun between 0 and 5 degrees, from a fitted formula on latitude.

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Invented fit on latitude, identical for both bodies.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Invented fit on latitude, identical to Earth; no horizon or polar-ridge illumination.

sun_low_frac_0_5deg.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

lst_diurnal_amp_k.label: Diurnal temperature amplitude

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Formula 8 + 22*bare + 0.0022*elev (land, max 38.75 K), 2.5 K on ocean; not MODIS.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong

lst_diurnal_amp_k.comparability_note: Same quantity on both bodies, but both are MODELLED formulas and the lunar one (latitude only, 63-180 K) is contradicted by Diviner (R2 section 3, R3 F10 and F12).

thermal_inertia_class.label: Thermal inertia class
thermal_inertia_class.description: Surface class from thresholds on bare fraction, roughness, slope and temperature.

EARTH.code: harmonizer_cleaner.py:268-274 thresholds on bare (0.22/0.42/0.55), rough>=110 or slope>=4; hielo if temp<261 K; agua if elev<=0
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Thresholds on modelled inputs; no thermal-inertia data is used.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Every lunar cell is 'suelo' because lunar rock never reaches the 0.22 threshold.

thermal_inertia_class.comparability_note: Classes are thresholds on rock_or_bare_frac, a different quantity on each body; every lunar cell is 'suelo' (A2 section 3).

permafrost_class.label: Permafrost class
permafrost_class.description: Permafrost continuity class from temperature thresholds (Earth) or latitude and temperature (Moon).

EARTH.code: harmonizer_cleaner.py:280-284 land & temp_k<=274.15 (or elev>=3400 & <=278) esporadico; <=270.15 discontinuo; <=265.15 continuo
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Thresholds on temp_k and elevation; the cited IPA permafrost map was not used.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Thresholds on |lat| and temp_k; a label borrowed from Earth, not lunar ice data.

permafrost_class.comparability_note: Permafrost is ground at or below 0 deg C for two years and has no lunar equivalent by definition (R3, ice row and F17); the lunar label is a latitude and temperature threshold.

rain_mm_day.label: Rain
rain_mm_day.description: Daily rain from a formula (Moon: constant 0).

EARTH.claimed_source: none cited in code (workable_days source: rover_preset ILUSTRATIVO)
EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Formula on bare fraction and latitude; no source cited.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Constant 0 (physically right, but set by code).

rain_mm_day.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

wind_max_ms.label: Maximum wind
wind_max_ms.description: Maximum wind speed from a formula (Moon: constant 0).

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Formula on elevation and latitude; no source cited.

MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Constant 0 (physically right, but set by code).

wind_max_ms.comparability_note: Same physical quantity on both bodies; see each body's level and caveat for how far the values can be trusted.

tmin_c.label: Minimum temperature

EARTH.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
EARTH.caveat: Formula on temp_k and the modelled amplitude; not an observed minimum.

MOON.code: same formula on Moon (subtracts up to 63 K from the night-time temp_k)
MOON.resolution_note: 2-degree cell (90 x 180 grid); the CSV column resolution_m = 500 is wrong
MOON.caveat: Subtracts up to 63 K from a night-time temp_k; not an observed minimum.

tmin_c.comparability_note: Same formula on both bodies (temp_k - 273.15 - 0.35 * amplitude); it inherits the caveats of temp_k and lst_diurnal_amp_k.
